capitalScope.en: Archived combined candidate, 5% participation assumption. Percentage values are already in percent units. Simulated impact is not calibrated; these rows do not estimate executable capacity.
capitalScope.zh: 归档复合候选，假定参与率5%。百分比沿用原表单位。模拟冲击未经校准，这些记录尚不能估算可执行容量。

matrixScope.en: Sixteen archived, already-inspected configurations. Development and later-period returns are descriptive; the later period is not an untouched test.
matrixScope.zh: 16组配置均已被研究者查看。开发段与后段收益用于历史描述，后段已参与比较。

caption.en: Bars share a zero baseline within the selected metric. The scale resets when the metric or frequency changes. The table retains every measure; scroll horizontally on small screens.
caption.zh: 同一图中各柱共用零基线，切换指标或频率后重设刻度。表格保留全部指标，小屏可横向滚动。
